verdict.rationale: Restate offers a cloud service, so whether customer data is used for AI training is a fair question. The pack contains no training opt-out, no no-training policy, and no data-usage commitment. Self-hosting and BYOC deployment options are an adjacent control, not a documented guarantee against training use, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
